questions.question: SLI (Service Level Indicator) nima?
questions.explanation: Servis sifatini o'lchaydigan miqdoriy ko'rsatkich (masalan, 200 ms dan tez va 200 status bilan qaytgan HTTP request'lar ulushi). Yaxshi SLI = foydalanuvchi tajribasini aks ettiradi.

questions.question: SLO (Service Level Objective) nima?
questions.explanation: Dev va SRE kelishgan ichki ishonchlilik maqsadi (masalan, 30 kunlik sirpanuvchi oynada request'larning 99.9% i SLI'ga mos).

questions.question: SLA (Service Level Agreement) nima?
questions.explanation: Mijoz bilan yuridik shartnoma: kelishilgan darajaga erishilmasa jarima (kredit, qaytarish). SLA odatda SLO'dan yumshoqroq bo'ladi (bufer).

questions.question: Error budget tugasa (0%) nima bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: Muhim bo'lmagan feature deploy'lar muzlatiladi, muhandislik resursi bug fix, texnik qarz va reliability ishiga yo'naltiriladi.

questions.question: SRE'da toil nima (to'liq ta'rif)?
questions.explanation: Qo'lda, takroriy, avtomatlashtirsa bo'ladigan, taktik, doimiy qiymat yaratmaydigan va servis o'sishi bilan chiziqli o'sadigan operatsion ish.

questions.question: Google SRE'ning toil uchun 50% qoidasi nima?
questions.explanation: SRE vaqtining ko'pi bilan 50% i toil va on-call'ga; qolgan 50%+ toil'ni butunlay yo'qotadigan muhandislik loyihalariga.

questions.question: Monitoringning to'rt "Golden Signal"i qanday?
questions.explanation: Latency (javob vaqti; muvaffaqiyatli va xatoli alohida), Traffic (talab/throughput), Errors (xatoli request'lar ulushi), Saturation (resurs to'lishga qanchalik yaqin).

questions.question: RED metodi nima?
questions.explanation: Request asosidagi servislar uchun: Rate (req/s), Errors (xatoli req/s), Duration (latency taqsimoti).

questions.question: USE metodi nima?
questions.explanation: Infra resurslari uchun: Utilization (band bo'lgan vaqt), Saturation (navbat chuqurligi), Errors (xato soni) — CPU, disk, tarmoq, xotira uchun.

questions.question: MTTD (Mean Time to Detect) nima?
questions.explanation: Incident boshlanishidan uni jamoa yoki monitoring aniqlagunga qadar o'rtacha vaqt.

questions.question: MTTR (Mean Time to Resolve/Restore) nima?
questions.explanation: Prod nosozligi aniqlangandan foydalanuvchilar uchun normal ishlash to'liq tiklanguncha o'rtacha vaqt.

questions.question: MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) nima?
questions.explanation: Tizim nosozliklari orasidagi o'rtacha vaqt — umumiy barqarorlik o'lchovi.

questions.question: MTTF (Mean Time to Failure) nima?
questions.explanation: Ta'mirlanmaydigan tizim yoki hardware komponentining to'liq ishdan chiqishigacha kutilgan ishlash vaqti.

questions.question: Blameless post-mortem (SRE kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Incident'dan keyingi strukturali, hamkorlikdagi retrospektiva: muhandislar yaxshi niyatda harakat qilgan deb hisoblanadi, e'tibor tizimli, arxitektura va jarayon sabablariga.

questions.question: Post-mortem hujjatining asosiy bo'limlari qanday?
questions.explanation: Qisqa xulosa va ta'sir, 2. UTC vaqt jadvali (timeline), 3. Root cause tahlili, 4. Nima yaxshi / yomon o'tdi, 5. Egasi va muddati bor SMART action item'lar.

questions.question: Root cause tahlilida 5 Whys texnikasi nima?
questions.explanation: Ketma-ket besh marta "Nega?" so'rab, yuzaki simptomdan tashkiliy yoki arxitektura asosiy sababigacha borish.

questions.question: Alert fatigue nima va qanday oldi olinadi?
questions.explanation: On-call muhandisni shovqinli, harakat talab qilmaydigan alert'lar bilan to'ldirish — natijada kritik incident o'tkazib yuboriladi. Faqat foydalanuvchiga ko'rinadigan SLO simptomlari va burn rate bo'yicha alert; har al...

questions.question: Multi-window multi-burn-rate alert (SRE) nima?
questions.explanation: Google SRE standarti: error budget sarflanish tezligi qisqa (masalan 5m/1h) va uzun (30m/6h) oynalarda hisoblanadi — budget tez yonayotgandagina page qilinadi.

questions.question: RTO (Recovery Time Objective) nima?
questions.explanation: Avariyadan keyin servis tiklanguncha ruxsat etilgan maksimal downtime davomiyligi.

questions.question: RPO (Recovery Point Objective) nima?
questions.explanation: Avariya nuqtasidan orqaga vaqt bilan o'lchanadigan ruxsat etilgan maksimal ma'lumot yo'qotish.

questions.question: On-call escalation policy nima?
questions.explanation: Paging tizimida (PagerDuty, Opsgenie) alert'ni primary on-call'ga yuboradigan va 5-10 daqiqada tasdiqlanmasa secondary yoki menejerga ko'taradigan oldindan belgilangan oqim.

questions.question: Incident Commander (IC) nima?
questions.explanation: Kritik avariya paytida tekshiruvni muvofiqlashtiradigan, rollarni taqsimlaydigan, kommunikatsiyani boshqaradigan va yuqori darajadagi tiklash qarorlarini qabul qiladigan tayinlangan rahbar. IC o'zi debug qilmaydi — ko...

questions.question: Runbook (playbook) nima?
questions.explanation: On-call uchun aniq alert yoki nosozlikni qanday diagnostika qilish, triage va hal qilishni qadam-baqadam tasvirlovchi texnik qo'llanma.

questions.question: Automated remediation nima?
questions.explanation: Dasturiy rutinalar (EventBridge, Lambda, operator'lar) bilan aniq nosozliklarni aniqlab, inson aralashuvisiz tuzatish (pod restart, disk kengaytirish). Xavfli action'lar uchun rate limit va guardrail kerak.

questions.question: SRE'da capacity planning nima?
questions.explanation: Organik o'sish va marketing sakrashlariga ko'ra kelajakdagi resurs talabini (compute, xotira, storage, IOPS) prognoz qilish — to'yinishdan oldin proaktiv scale.

questions.question: Load shedding (SRE) nima?
questions.explanation: Server to'yinishga yaqinlashganda kritik tranzaksiyalar past latency bilan o'tishi uchun past prioritetli request'larni ataylab tashlash.

questions.question: Graceful degradation (SRE) nima?
questions.explanation: Muhim bo'lmagan downstream servis yiqilganda ilova kamaytirilgan funksiya bilan ishlashda davom etadi (masalan recommendation engine o'chsa statik tavsiyalar).

questions.question: Thundering herd muammosi (retry kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Minglab client yiqilgan request'ni bir xil millisekundda qayta urinib, endi tiklanayotgan backend'ni yana yiqitadi. Jitter bilan exponential backoff va retry budget bilan oldi olinadi.

questions.question: Jitter bilan exponential backoff (SRE) nima?
questions.explanation: Har urinishda kutish vaqti ikki baravar (2^n) va tasodifiy jitter qo'shiladi — client'lar retry'lari sinxronlashmaydi.

questions.question: High availability (HA) nima?
questions.explanation: Komponentlarni bir nechta failure domain'larda (AZ, region) redundant qilib, single point of failure'siz uzluksiz ishlashni ta'minlash.

questions.question: "Three nines", "four nines" va "five nines" nimani anglatadi?
questions.explanation: % — oyiga max ~43 daqiqa downtime; 99.99% — ~4.3 daqiqa; 99.999% — ~26 soniya. Har qo'shimcha "to'qqiz" narxi eksponensial oshadi.

questions.question: Active-active va active-passive HA farqi.
questions.explanation: Active-active — bir nechta redundant tizim bir vaqtda jonli trafikni qayta ishlaydi; active-passive — primary ishlaydi, secondary kutib turadi va failover'da o'rnini egallaydi.

questions.question: Distributed tizimlarda split-brain nima?
questions.explanation: Tarmoq bo'linishi natijasida ikki tomon bir-birini o'lgan deb hisoblab mustaqil leader saylashi — jiddiy ma'lumot buzilishi.

questions.question: Split-brain qanday oldi olinadi?
questions.explanation: Leader election'da qat'iy quorum (⌊N/2⌋ + 1), toq sonli node (3, 5, 7) va fencing (eski leader'ni yozishdan to'sish).

questions.question: CAP teoremasi (SRE kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Network partition bo'lganda tizim Consistency (hamma bir xil ma'lumot ko'radi) yoki Availability (har request xatosiz javob) dan birini tanlaydi.

questions.question: PACELC (SRE kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Partition bo'lsa — A yoki C; aks holda (normal holatda) — Latency yoki Consistency.

questions.question: Eventual consistency nima?
questions.explanation: Yangi yozuvlar bo'lmasa, barcha replikalar oxir-oqibat bir xil eng so'nggi qiymatga yaqinlashadi. Oraliqda eski qiymat o'qilishi mumkin.

questions.question: Distributed tracing (SRE kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Bitta request'ning bir nechta servis bo'ylab end-to-end yo'lini kuzatish — har span latency hissasini va bottleneck'ni ko'rsatadi.

questions.question: Continuous profiling (SRE kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Prod'dan CPU, xotira va lock contention call stack'larini past overhead bilan doimiy yig'ish (eBPF, Pyroscope).

questions.question: Blackbox probing nima?
questions.explanation: Infra tashqarisidan endpoint'larni tekshirish (HTTP GET, TCP SYN, DNS) — foydalanuvchiga ko'rinadigan mavjudlikni tasdiqlash (Prometheus blackbox_exporter).

questions.question: Whitebox monitoring nima?
questions.explanation: Kod ichidan chiqariladigan runtime metrikalarini (JVM heap, thread soni, DB pool holati) kuzatish.

questions.question: High cardinality (SRE kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Label'larda juda ko'p unikal qiymat (user_id, email) — TSDB xotirasini tugatadi. Bunday ma'lumot log/trace'ga tegishli, metrikaga emas.

questions.question: Synthetic monitoring nima?
questions.explanation: Avtomatik skript yoki headless brauzer bot'lari user journey'larni (qidiruv, savatga qo'shish, to'lov) muntazam bajarib, nosozlikni foydalanuvchidan oldin topadi.

questions.question: Real User Monitoring (RUM) nima?
questions.explanation: Foydalanuvchi brauzeri yoki mobil ilovasidan bevosita yig'iladigan telemetriya — haqiqiy sahifa yuklanish, tarmoq latency va JS xatolari.

questions.question: Service dependency graph nima?
questions.explanation: Mikroservislar, DB va third-party API'lar orasidagi upstream/downstream bog'liqliklarning dinamik vizual topologiyasi.

questions.question: Dark traffic mirroring (shadowing) nima?
questions.explanation: Jonli request'larni nusxalab yangi versiyaga asinxron yuborish (javob foydalanuvchiga qaytmaydi) — real payload bilan unumdorlikni sinash. Side effect'li (yozuvchi) request'larda ehtiyot bo'ling.

questions.question: Error budget policy (SRE) nima?
questions.explanation: Error budget nolga yetganda kelishilgan cheklovlarni (deploy freeze, reliability'ga fokus) belgilovchi rasmiy kelishuv.

questions.question: Chaos Mesh (SRE kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: CRD'lar orqali pod failure, network latency, CPU stress, I/O buzilishi kiritadigan Kubernetes chaos platformasi.

questions.question: Observability as Code (OaC) nima?
questions.explanation: Grafana dashboard'lari, Prometheus alert qoidalari va OTel collector konfiguratsiyasini Git'da versiyalanadigan deklarativ kod sifatida saqlash.
